binaries.description: Binaries fetched from an upstream release, keyed by OS family.

additionalProperties.description: Keyed by group: 'common' plus one key per role name.

name.description: Binary name. Also the dpkg package name for install: deb, and the file extracted from a tarball.

repo.description: GitHub owner/repo, used for the release download and the upstream freshness check.

version.description: Pinned version, without a leading v.

install.description: How it is installed. 'local-build' compiles it here; 'manual' is never fetched -- pinned and reported only.

tag.description: Release tag pattern; {version} is substituted. Usually 'v{version}' or '{version}'.

asset.description: Release asset filename; {version} and {arch} are substituted. Required unless install is manual.

version_cmd.description: Command printing the installed version. Unused for install: deb, which reads dpkg-query.

toolchain.description: Compiler package the build needs, e.g. golang-1.27-go. Required for install: local-build, and must itself be declared in packages.yaml.

build.description: Command run in an empty directory, producing a file named `name`. {version} and {arch} are substituted.

restart.description: Command run after a successful install, so the new binary is the one running.
